title: Morning, the crab boats
logline: One of the mornings with the crab boats out past the bar, small, their lights still on in the dawn, the flats in front. Thirty years of Derbies in the boats' shape. The pup not looking at them.

panels.composition: Dawn over mudflats with three small crab boats far out past a sandbar with their lights still on, an old three-legged dog in the foreground looking the other way.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, dawn over tidal mudflats with three small crab boats far out past a sandbar with their lights still on and an old three-legged dog in the foreground looking the other way, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
